summary: Tested M2.1 freeze fix: (1) new gd-m2-website-gate v4 bundle backend rule bundle (dedicated row-4.1 DNS-capability rule) and (2) frontend regression on /phase6-automated after phase6AutomatedHarness.ts row-4.1 rewrite. Backend: 14/14 pytest checks passed covering bundle version/rule-count/content, signature+payloadHash cryptographic verification via verify_bundle(), M1 frozen bundle unaffected, and /api/config unaffected. Frontend: app boots cleanly (GD_SMOKE_READY logged, native:false), navigated to /phase6-automated, tapped Run -> correctly short-circuits at PRECONDITION_FAILURE/NATIVE_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE (expected on web) with zero console/page errors. Native VPN/DNS-capability logic itself is untestable outside a physical Android device, as scoped.

verified_working.backend_bundle_v4: GET /api/rules/gd-m2-website-gate/latest returns bundleVersion=4 with exactly 4 rules: m2-block-blocktest-001 (blocktest.btciq.app/block, unchanged), m2-kotlin-test-allow-001, m2-kotlin-test-block-001 (unchanged), and new m2-block-dns-capability-001 (dnsprobe.blocktest.btciq.app/block).
verified_working.backend_signature: Envelope signature verified end-to-end via app.services.rule_signer.verify_bundle() against known test Ed25519 pubkeys (gd-m1-test-ed25519-001/002) -- schema, payloadHash, keyId trust, signature, issued/expiry all accepted=True. payloadHash also independently recomputed via payload_hash() and matches exactly.
verified_working.backend_m1_frozen: GET /api/rules/gd-m1-controlled-block/latest still returns bundleVersion=25 (frozen), completely unaffected.
verified_working.backend_config: GET /api/config returns gateGuard.websiteGateRulesetId='gd-m2-website-gate' correctly, M1 capabilities/signing fields intact.
verified_working.add_dns_capability_rule_script: Re-ran backend/scripts/add_dns_capability_rule.py --confirm -- correctly reports NO-OP (idempotent), confirming bundle v4 with the new rule was already published and the script does not duplicate/re-sign unnecessarily.
verified_working.frontend_smoke: GD_SMOKE_READY log present in expo.out.log after harness.ts edit, native:false as expected on web, no bundler crash.
verified_working.frontend_phase6_automated_route: Navigated to /phase6-automated, tapped 'Run Automated Acceptance' -> Result card renders PRECONDITION_FAILURE/NATIVE_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE within ~4s, Technical Evidence toggle, PDF/JSON export, and Start new run buttons all render. Zero console errors, zero page errors captured.

critical_code_review_comments: phase6AutomatedHarness.ts runDnsCapabilityCheck() attribution logic (strict per-row host+ruleId matching, excluding unrelated events as noise rather than upgrading them into this row's verdict) reviewed and is logically sound -- cannot be exercised beyond static review outside a physical Android device (native-check precondition short-circuits before row 4.1 in this environment, as scoped).

add_dns_capability_rule.py correctly refuses (exit 2) if no prior bundle exists, correctly no-ops if the rule/host is already present, and carries forward every existing rule byte-for-byte via RuleEntry(**r.model_dump()) before appending only the new rule -- matches the additive-only guarantee claimed in its docstring.
Groups 1-3 (rows 1.1-3.5) logic was NOT re-evaluated per instructions (frozen/already physically verified) -- only confirmed no regression via web smoke test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of web-preview-reachable checks (app boot + /phase6-automated precondition path); native VPN/DNS-capability enforcement logic (rows 1.1-4.1) remains untestable outside a physical Android device build, as explicitly scoped out of this test pass.
